boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 107 layers creature markers, dual padlocks, and a right-arrow feed tile onto an irregular brick board. The blue and purple locks gate the two halves of the grid, and the bottom `3` tray is a counter gate — not a free refill. The tall yellow cluster on the left and the red C-shape on the right compete for the same lane, so clearing the locks in the wrong order jams the feed.
landmarks: Block Out Level 107 layers creature markers, dual padlocks, and a right-arrow feed tile onto an irregular brick board.
The blue and purple locks gate the two halves of the grid, and the bottom `3` tray is a counter gate — not a free refill.
The tall yellow cluster on the left and the red C-shape on the right compete for the same lane, so clearing the locks in the wrong order jams the feed.

quickTips: Open the blue padlock before the purple one — the lower green arrow lane depends on that order.
Do not spend the bottom `3` tray while either padlock is still closed.
Think in chain clears. The best move is the one that sets up the next two moves, not just the quickest current match.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Remove the top green creature tile and the middle yellow troll tile.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Break the upper-left red/yellow/blue cluster without sliding into either padlock.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Feed the right-arrow orange block through the open right channel.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Open the blue padlock in the lower-left, then the purple padlock in the lower-center.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Slide the lower green arrow tile through the opened lower lane.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Spend the bottom orange `3` tray to close counters `5` and `4`, then clear the blue L-shape marked `1`.

failurePoints: Spending the bottom `3` tray before both padlocks are open — this boxes in the lower green arrow tile.
Feeding the right-arrow orange tile before the upper-middle gap is actually clear.
